inputs.approval_record: The S49 approval record (approval.schema.json) of type launch_plan_build bound to the launch plan document hash.
inputs.brand_facts: A brand facts document carrying brand_ref, founder_name (the founder's actual name), brand_voice, an optional declared brand_hash, and a provenance block.
inputs.intake_session: The S49 intake session document (schema signature-launch-intake/v1): the answer ledger with per-answer state and source_ref, the session plan_hash, the client identity reference, and status approved or building.
inputs.landing_facts: A landing facts document in the shape of examples/golden-signature-launch-10/landing-facts.json (section 5 why, section 6 who with exactly three pains carrying refs, sections 8, 9 and 10, round_timing with ref and fact, testimonial_evidence present as evidence entries or an explicit null), plus a provenance block.
inputs.launch_record: The S49 launch record (schema/launch.schema.json, version 1.0): offers with per-offer source_kind and source_ref, brand_ref and brand_hash, revision, and plan_approval_ref.

law: Every consumed field carries a provenance entry (state, source_kind, source_ref, and where the fact lives in a document, the document reference and its sha256). Bare answered flags are not evidence and are never emitted or accepted.

No fabricated attestations: a launch brief never sets asked_all_at_once, one_question_per_turn, or question_block_msg_id. Those flags describe the legacy one-block conversation and would be false statements about a launch intake.

Approval binds to the exact plan: the adapter recomputes the launch plan document hash (the S49 canonicalization, status and plan_approval_ref excluded) and refuses unless it equals both the intake session plan_hash and the approval record subject_hash.

A worker cannot approve its own work: the approval record approver must be the launch client identity recorded in the intake session and must differ from the worker identity operating the adapter when one is supplied.
Approval types are separate and scope is checked: the approval record subject_type must be launch_plan_build and its scope list must contain launch_plan_build. A revoked approval authorizes nothing.

Unknown is not zero and blank is not not_applicable: a consumed field whose provenance state is unknown or recommended_unapproved is refused. not_applicable is valid only for testimonial evidence, where it produces an explicit null.
The legacy intake contract is untouched by this path: intake/email-intake-questions.json keeps its required set, and test_intake_contract_authority.py remains the authority over it.
owner: S50 (Skill 50 Email Engine), consuming the S49-owned Signature Launch intake
purpose: The shared-launch brief contract for the signature_launch_landing_10 email profile. A launch brief is assembled by tools/launch_intake_adapter.py from the approved S49 launch intake artifacts and is consumed by tools/prove-email.py under intake_mode signature_launch. It is a SEPARATE intake path from the legacy one-block questionnaire in intake/email-intake-questions.json: the legacy contract, its required answer set, and its attestation flags are never read, reused, or mutated by this path.
refusals: the session is not in status approved or building, or the session holds no plan hash
the recomputed plan document hash differs from the session plan_hash or from the approval subject_hash (the plan changed after approval)

the approval record is missing a required field, has the wrong subject_type, a scope that does not contain launch_plan_build, revoked true, an unrecognized verification_class, a future recorded_at, no owner identity, no source message reference, an approver who is not the launch client, or an approver equal to the worker identity
the launch record plan_approval_ref does not name the approval record approval_id

the launch record is not schema version 1.0, is not in an approved or building status, has no main offer, has a main offer without display_name or provenance, or carries an unknown price while approved
a consumed intake ledger answer is missing, or its state is unknown or recommended_unapproved

the brand facts brand_ref differs from the launch record brand_ref, a declared brand_hash differs, founder_name or brand_voice is empty, or the brand facts provenance is missing or not in a consumed state

the landing facts are bound to a different launch or a different offer, the section 5 why is empty, the section 6 pains are not exactly three with distinct refs, any of sections 8, 9, 10 is empty, round_timing lacks a ref or fact, testimonial_evidence is absent rather than explicitly null, testimonial evidence contradicts a not_applicable proof answer, a declared deadline lacks brief provenance, or the landing facts provenance is missing or not in a consumed state
an override names a channel outside the locked overrides channel or its ledger entry is not in a consumed state
